title: Financial Terms of the Ancillary Account: Statements, Payment and Settlement (Ancillary and Optional Services Billing)
content:
1. **Billing cycle.** Ancillary charges under Ancillary and Optional Services Billing are billed monthly in arrears.
2. **Statement date.** The prior month's ancillary charges are billed on day 4 of the month.
3. **Due date.** Charges are due 30 calendar days after the statement date.
4. **Methods of payment.** Check, ACH, card and trust transfer are accepted for ancillary charges.
5. **Rounding.** Ancillary charges are rounded half up to the cent, row by row.
6. **Closing.** An account is closed only with a zero balance.
7. **The ancillary receivable.** The account's balance is the ancillary and optional-service charges the resident owes: charges and Part B cost-sharing add to it; payments and credits subtract from it.

These terms are identical in every ancillary account tier, from Ancillary Account, Medicare Part A Consolidated Billing through Ancillary Account, Hospice Election.

## Worked dates and amounts (hypothetical)

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| Charges for services in February 2026 | Billed on the statement dated 4 March 2026 |
| Statement dated 4 March 2026 | Due 3 April 2026, 30 calendar days after the statement date |
| A charge row computing to USD 28.815 | Rounded half up to USD 28.82 |
| A charge row computing to USD 28.8149 | Rounded to USD 28.81 |
| Balance of USD 0.00 | The account may be closed |
| Balance of USD 13.06 | The account is not closed |
